project_metadata.description: Domain model generated from SRS via DDD-Enforcer pipeline

business_rules: Users need to create password containing minimum of 8 alphanumeric characters with both uppercase and lowercase letters including a number.
Users need to verify their email after registering to enter the platform as registered user.

entities.name: User
entities.description: Represents a user of the platform, storing personal details, contact information, and credentials.
entities.justification: The text explicitly defines a User table and user characteristics for registration, login, and profile management.

value_objects.name: Password
value_objects.description: Represents a secure password requiring specific character combinations.

value_objects.name: Credentials
value_objects.description: The combination of username or email and password used for authentication.

services.name: UserRegistrationService
services.description: Handles the registration process for non-registered users and email verification.

services.name: AuthenticationService
services.description: Authenticates users by matching their username or email and password.

aggregates.name: User
aggregates.description: Consistency boundary around the User entity, managing profile and authentication details.

business_rules: Only the registered users can add products.

entities.name: Product
entities.description: Represents an item listed for sale in the catalog, containing basic properties and categorization.
entities.justification: The text explicitly defines a Products table with these attributes.

entities.name: ProductDetails
entities.description: Contains the detailed information of the products uploaded for sale, including description and images.
entities.justification: The text explicitly defines a Product details table with extended information.

value_objects.name: Warranty
value_objects.description: Represents the warranty period and conditions for a product.

value_objects.name: ProductCondition
value_objects.description: Represents the physical condition and usage duration of a product.

value_objects.name: DeliveryInfo
value_objects.description: Represents the home delivery service details for a product.

services.name: ProductSearchService
services.description: Allows users to search for products using keywords or through categories.

aggregates.name: Product
aggregates.description: Consistency boundary around a product and its detailed information, warranty, condition, and delivery info.

entities.name: Offer
entities.description: Represents an offer made by a buyer to a seller for a product.
entities.justification: The Offers table stores data about offers received from users or probable buyers.

entities.name: Request
entities.description: Represents a request made by a registered user to buy a product.
entities.justification: The Requests table stores information about requests made by registered users.

aggregates.name: Offer
aggregates.description: Consistency boundary for an offer made between a buyer and a seller.

aggregates.name: Request
aggregates.description: Consistency boundary for a request made by a buyer.

business_rules: To contact a developer, the user must provide their name, email, and a message.

entities.name: ContactMessage
entities.description: Represents a message sent by a user to contact the developer for support or inquiries.
entities.justification: The text specifies that users can contact developers by providing their name, email, and a message.

entities.name: UserManual
entities.description: Represents the help documentation containing instructions for using the platform.
entities.justification: The text mentions a website user manual on the help page containing instructions on how to use the platform.

value_objects.name: SocialMediaLink
value_objects.description: Represents a link to a developer's social media profile used for contact.

services.name: ContactDeveloperService
services.description: Handles the process of sending a contact message to a developer.

aggregates.name: ContactMessage
aggregates.description: Consistency boundary for a contact message sent to a developer.

aggregates.name: UserManual
aggregates.description: Consistency boundary for the website user manual and its instructions.
